claims.claim: The 18th Amendment was ratified on January 16, 1919, and Prohibition took effect one year later, on January 17, 1920.
claims.episode_span: The 18th Amendment itself was ratified on January 16, 1919, and took effect one year later
claims.source_title: Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution - Wikipedia
claims.supporting_quote: Under the terms of the Eighteenth Amendment, Prohibition began on January 17, 1920, one year after the amendment was ratified

claims.claim: The Volstead Act became law in October 1919 (October 28, over President Wilson's veto).
claims.episode_span: Congress passed the Volstead Act in October 1919 to define “intoxicating” beverages
claims.supporting_quote: President Woodrow Wilson vetoed the bill, Congress overrode his veto, and the bill went through on October 28, 1919

claims.claim: The Volstead Act defined intoxicating beverages as those containing more than 0.5 percent alcohol.
claims.episode_span: to define “intoxicating” beverages as anything over 0.5 percent alcohol
claims.supporting_quote: Permanent National Prohibition," which was defined as "intoxicating beverages" containing greater than 0.5 percent alcohol

claims.claim: Al Capone was a lieutenant of Johnny Torrio, head of a Chicago syndicate that illegally supplied alcohol.
claims.episode_span: In Chicago, Johnny Torrio and his lieutenant Al Capone organized breweries and distribution routes
claims.supporting_quote: Capone moved to Chicago and became a bodyguard of Johnny Torrio , head of a criminal syndicate that illegally supplied alcohol

claims.claim: Capone's organization grossed an estimated $105 million in 1927, mainly from illegal liquor - consistent with 'roughly $100 million a year by 1927'.
claims.episode_span: organized breweries and distribution routes that generated roughly $100 million a year by 1927
claims.source_title: Highest gross income in a single year by a private citizen | Guinness World Records
claims.supporting_quote: The highest gross income ever achieved in a single year by a private citizen is an estimated $105 million (then £21.5 million) in 1927 by the Chicago gangster Alphonse

claims.claim: In the Saint Valentine's Day Massacre of 1929, seven members and associates of Chicago's North Side Gang were shot dead in a garage.
claims.episode_span: the Saint Valentine’s Day Massacre of 1929, in which seven men were machine-gunned in a garage
claims.supporting_quote: The Saint Valentine's Day Massacre was the murder of seven members and associates of Chicago's North Side Gang on Saint Valentine's Day 1929

claims.claim: Federal officials ordered the poisoning of industrial alcohol, which bootleggers routinely stole and resold as drinkable liquor; the program is estimated to have killed at least 10,000 people by 1933.
claims.episode_span: The federal government continued to require methanol and other poisons in industrial stocks
claims.supporting_quote: They ordered the poisoning of industrial alcohols manufactured in the United States, products regularly stolen by bootleggers and resold as drinkable spirits

claims.claim: The federal government initially funded only about 1,500 Prohibition agents for the entire country.
claims.episode_span: The federal government initially assigned only 1,500 agents to patrol the entire country
claims.source_title: Prohibition Agents Lacked Training, Numbers to Battle Bootleggers - The Mob Museum
claims.supporting_quote: The government provided funds for only 1,500 agents at first to enforce Prohibition across the country

claims.claim: The 18th Amendment was repealed by the 21st Amendment on December 5, 1933 - the only constitutional amendment ever repealed.
claims.episode_span: the 21st Amendment was ratified on December 5, 1933, ending national prohibition after thirteen years
claims.source_title: Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution - Wikipedia
claims.supporting_quote: The Eighteenth Amendment was repealed by the Twenty-first Amendment on December 5, 1933, making it the only constitutional amendment in American history to be repealed
